conclusion.scientific_summary: Empirical gradient optimization on diagnostic inputs+outputs remains the strongest repair method when behavioral failure examples and weights are both present. For the LLM proposer, providing explicit weight summaries and first-order sensitivity directions (full_diagnostic_toolkit) reduces blind guessing relative to behavioral_only, while small 0.5B-1.5B LLMs frequently propose imprecise magnitudes or fail on sign-inversion defects compared to gradient descent.
